title: What if you fell into a volcano?
voiceStatus: estimated (run a TTS tool with word timestamps and regenerate vo.gen.ts)

vo.text: What if you fell into a volcano?
Basalt lava runs around 1,100 degrees Celsius.
Lava is three times denser than you. You float.
A hundred thousand times thicker than water. No swimming out.
So you'd lie on top. And burn.
So… what if you fell into a volcano?
